attempts.attempt: At address 00: first domain test fails; at 01: first domain and second value; at 10: first domain and first value; at 11: first domain and both value tests. All other tests pass.
After pivot 2 then 4 on the cycled board weights become (1,0,0,0). Preparation p=1/4; successful next pivot 1. theta=pi/6, so one Grover iterate gives sin^2(3theta)=1.
Two fixed distinct positions per column: independent I hit with probability 1/2. Adaptively chosen found-zero I hit when at least one zero was found: 1-(1/2)^4=15/16.

On a=0, an early cell guess at time 3 contributes if the full run remains light; stopping at the cell query ensures that. Its successful event a=0,b=0,c=d has probability 1/8. Together with original a=1,b=0,c=d event 1/8, total light true-cell probability 1/4. If it subsequently reads c it becomes heavy and is not counted.
k=4 excludes every alpha<3.5, so alpha_tot>=3.5, but this argument does not itself exclude alpha=3.5. Need k>4, i.e. any integer k>=5; k=5 gives d=1/20.
